title: On computing the length of longest increasing subsequences
author: Michael L. Fredman
accessible_evidence: Primary publisher abstract returned by web search and the indexed introduction of the university-hosted primary PDF. They state n distinct linearly ordered elements, the comparison model, n log n−n log log n+O(n) worst-case comparisons and worst-case optimality.

full_pdf_attempt.result: Browser fetch and a bounded direct request timed out. Publisher full page returned403. No full-PDF proof review claimed.

independently_proved: The exact deletion-insertion distance, a constructive upper bound for moves, rank-invariant applicability and the sharp algorithmic comparison upper bound. The minimum-tail invariant is reused from P0403.
external_dependency: The matching comparison-tree lower bound is an explicitly cited primary theorem; its full proof has not been independently reread.
